description: When to call: you have a question or a payload and want the cheapest verified step. MATCH lists program classes and pages (free without input). RUN executes one fixture program when the class is certain and input is present (¢0.1). Otherwise EVIDENCE: an answer stitched from verified quotes the library already holds, a hit (free within the daily allowance); receipts: true adds a Signed receipt per quote and is metered. Set allow_escalate only to send YOUR ask to YOUR engine. A miss names research/deposit with prices. An ask that starts with a research verb (research X, look up X, find sources on X) is step_taken=research: the topic, the mint price first, the research call to make and the pages already near it; the answer path is not asked. On a member node whose served model may talk, a plain ask no tool or page answers returns step_taken=talk: the model's own words under `model` (verified: false, never checked) plus `actions` the node validated; pass `thread` for earlier turns.

class_id.description: Force a program class when you already know it

input.description: Payload to run through a matched program

receipts.description: A Signed receipt per quote on EVIDENCE (default false; with receipts the step is metered)

think_harder.description: TALK with the model's thinking on and a longer budget

thread.description: Earlier turns for TALK: [{who: person|model|library, text}]

name: ask
title: MATCH, RUN, or EVIDENCE (run 0.0010); evidence is a hit without receipts
